w: Swamishri left Bhuj at 9.45 a.m. Swamishri was welcomed by a devotee, Jadavjibhai, on the occasion of a 7-day discourse on the Shrimad Bhagvat in memory of his deceased father.
In an assembly Jadavjibhai revealed the change in his life since he met Pramukh Swami Maharaj:

"My occupation was to roll bidis and my father too was in this business. I used to eat meat, drink and gamble. But everything changed the day I met Pitambarbhai (Chevdavala). He tried his best to inspire me to give up my bad habits. Finally he took me to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. It was my first meeting with Swamishri. Swamishri asked me whether I had any addictions. I said yes. Then he asked me what shall I give up. I replied nothing. But Swamishri lovingly explained everything and I left with a pledge to give up everything. Then, I did not have a home of my own. I was paying rent for my shop and home. But after accepting Satsang, my three brothers and I, have our own shops and homes. We all live with unity and harmony. Today Swamishri has fulfilled my wish by blessing us and I cannot describe the joy and happiness I am experiencing in his presence. By the grace of Swamishri the Satsang in Khavda has flourished. In the weekly Sunday assembly 350-400 devotees attend for Satsang..."
Everyone realised how the power of Satsang can transform an immoral person into a virtuous devotee.
In his blessings, Swamishri praised the conviction and devotion of the late Pitambarbhai and emphasised the need of an addiction-free life and devotion to God.

ph: Gift presented to Hon. Kevin Sheller

w: At 10.15 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Undel to perform the murti-pratishtha of the new hari mandir.

In the evening, Swamishri blessed the assembly of 4,500 volunteers who would be engaged in various services during the Fuldol celebration two days later. Swamishri said, “Whatever duties that are assigned to you must be fulfilled… This service that you have got is very rare. In the services done for society one gets name and fame. One benefits in all ways, in money, but the benefit of this service is very great. To do according to the word of Maharaj and Swami is very important… When God becomes happy then there is nothing comparable to that…” Finally, Swamishri showered holy coloured water on sadhus and volunteers. The assembly concluded at 7.30 pm.
Thereafter Swamishri, who had contracted a malarial fever, retired to his room.

At 7.30 p.m. The festival assembly included speeches and kirtans by sadhus and dramas and dances by youths. The celebration assembly theme was ‘Bhagwan Swaminarayan – the Propagator of Ekantik Dharma.’ Brahmadarshan Swami gave an introductory speech on the theme, Ghanshyamcharan Swami spoke about the spreading of dharma, jnan and vairagya. A drama on Abhaysinh Bapu’s (Lodhika) steadfastness in satsang niyams was enacted by youths. Siddheshwar Swami spoke about ‘Bhagwan Swaminarayan, the Propagator of Bhakti.’ Thereafter another drama on Khimo Suthar was performed. Then Swamishri inaugurated new publications by Swaminarayan Aksharpith: Andhkar se Prakash ki Aur and Adhyatma Vibhuti Yogiji Maharaj by Vivekpriya Swami and Sanskruti Ke Adharsthambh – Shastra, Mandir, Sant in Hindi. ThereafterViveksagar Swami spoke about ‘Satpurush – The Upholder of Ekantik Dharma.’ Then Swamishri was honoured with garlands by the senior sadhus. A kirtan was sung and a traditional dance was performed. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Shriji Maharaj came to earth and accomplished an extraordinary task of establishing ekantik dharma. He also initiated sadhus who abided by a code of moral conduct and upasana and inspired the development of staunch devotees. Shriji Maharaj has declared in the Vachanamrut that he had not come alone to earth but had brought with him his abode, Mul Akshar Gunatitanand Swami, his divine powers and many muktas. His mission was to grace countless souls with liberation. During his short life of 49 years he travelled in the harsh forests, met yogis and liberated them and came to Loj and met Muktanand Swami…. If we wish to become brahmarup we need to be wedded firmly to agna and upasana. And the Satpurush who is wedded to both is the means to moksha.” At 10.10 p.m. Swamishri performed the birthday celebration arti.
